title: Fix dialog closedby and requestClose()
body: Update dialog to minimally handle open attribute mutations We define two new algorithms for dialog: 1. Dialog cleanup steps which: 1. Removes dialog from the document's open dialogs list 2. Destroy close watcher (if the dialog has no open attribute) 2. Dialog setup steps which: 1. Creates the dialog's close watcher. 2. Adds dialog to the document's open dialogs list. We also define attribute change steps and HTML element insertion steps for the dialog element. We call dialog cleanup steps when: a) An open dialog is removed from the document b) A dialog has its open attribute removed We call dialog setup steps when: a) An open dialog is inserted into the document b) A dialog has an open attribute added to it This fixes spec issues that can lead to assertions being hit but also incorrect behaviour. This also fixes closedby not working as expected for initially open dialogs. Fixes #10953, #10982 and #11259 - [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium - Already implements a version of this. * … - [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * This behaviour is already enforced by multiple Web platform tests. e.g. https://wpt.live/html/semantics/interactive-elements/the-dialog-element/dialog-remove-open-attr-crash.html * Added better test coverage for requestClose and initially open dialogs: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/50432 * https://wpt.live/html/semantics/interactive-elements/the-dialog-element/dialog-closedby-start-open.html - Added by Chromium change * Added a new test that doesn't rely on Assertions: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/50393 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: N/A * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1936940 (meta bug) * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=284592 (meta bug) - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: n/A - [ x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [ ] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
